schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 046 - IDE File Operation Boundary

questions.label: Should the IDE plugin own save and revert UI?
questions.help: Recommended: IDE owns editor save/revert UI and can also contribute OS menu commands when active. Core shell should not own editor-specific controls.
options: IDE owns save/revert UI and contributes OS menu commands when active

questions.label: Should file create, rename, and delete be part of the IDE plugin scope?
questions.help: Recommended: include create and rename; guarded delete with confirmation can be included because the File Explorer already owns file context.
options: Include create, rename, and guarded delete with confirmation
Include create and rename only; defer delete
FS plugin owns these operations instead

questions.label: If IDE delete is included, what should delete do?
questions.help: Recommended: guarded delete asks for confirmation and uses OS trash/recycle where available rather than permanent deletion by default.
options: Confirm and move to OS trash/recycle when available
Ask whether to trash or permanently delete every time

questions.label: How should IDE handle external file changes?
questions.help: Recommended: detect external changes, show conflict state, and require user choice before overwriting.
options: Detect changes, show conflict state, and require user choice before overwrite

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether folders are included, how dirty state appears, whether delete should be allowed outside trusted roots, or how save/revert interacts with app-tool approval policy.
